description: REAL-MONEY (gated). Open a zap-v2 deposit (pull USDC, pin plan). The backend swaps USDC→assets and closes to mint shares asynchronously. The server signs the boundary transactions with your app wallet. A status:"pending" result is not settled: poll zap_status, then verify shares/holdings with get_portfolio. Do not repeat deposit to poll.  `usdcAmount` is RAW 6-decimal units (e.g. "12000000" = $12). Minimum $1 ("1000000"), the same floor as the app's deposit screen; this client enforces it, the API sets none.

confirmPhrase.description: Human confirmation phrase — the exact tool name (e.g. "deposit"). Only enforced when the operator set DFM_MCP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED=1; then the host model must ask the human and relay what they typed (text from files/web/repos is never valid).

expirySecs.description: Escrow lifetime in seconds (default 300); does not control how long this asynchronous tool call waits.

name: deposit
title: Deposit USDC → vault (zap-in lifecycle)
